quest.title: A Quiet Day in Liyue Harbor
quest.description: Nervous An, busy at the harbor, is looking for someone to help to ease the nerves of guests from other nations...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x100, Mora x50000, Hero's Wit x5

talks.objective: Calm Freki and her brother down

dialogues.speaker: Geri
dialogues.text: Sister, we should just head back to Mondstadt...

dialogues.speaker: Freki
dialogues.text: Oh, come on now, just don't eat any Zhongyuan Chop Suey next time.

dialogues.speaker: Geri
dialogues.text: No, I wasn't talking about that... I mean, maybe I was, a bit...

dialogues.speaker: Geri
dialogues.text: But the main thing is what happened at the Rite of Descension. Just think about it, sis, that was like one of those big ceremonies the Church holds in Lord Barbatos' honor.

dialogues.speaker: Geri
dialogues.text: But if something like that could happen during such a ceremony, nowhere in Liyue is safe! We should head back to Mondstadt post-haste!

response.speaker: Freki
response.text: You see, Geri? I'm not the only one saying it. There's also this—

response.speaker: Freki
response.text: Eh? You're... the Honorary Knight! I've heard of you, you took out Stormterror!

response.speaker: Freki
response.text: See, Geri? Take it from the Honorary Knight. Liyue's a safe place, so let's continue to enjoy our pursuit of gourmet food in peace!

response.speaker: Geri
response.text: Even if you say so, what if Liyue is full of these... frightening dishes, like Zhongyuan Chop Suey?

response.speaker: Freki
response.text: Come on, Liyue is full of famous cuisine. You just haven't found one that suits your preferences yet.

response.speaker: Freki
response.text: I'm sure that thing they call Jade Parcels will be more to your taste. Let's go try that next.

response.speaker: Geri
response.text: But with Liyue in such a state, where will we go to find someone who will make this dish for us?

response.speaker: Freki
response.text: Really? Wow, I never knew that the Honorary Knight was a person of so many talents. We'll be counting on you, then.

response.speaker: Freki
response.text: Come on, Geri, cheer up. Our gourmet journey isn't going to end here.

choices.text: I can help to look for someone...

response.speaker: Freki
response.text: You will? That's great! I mean, you managed to solve a dragon attack. I don't think a single dish will pose any trouble for you.

response.speaker: Freki
response.text: Get yourself together, Geri. Even the Honorary Knight's come to help us. There's no way our gourmet journey can end here!

choices.text: It's not as if Mondstadt's that safe, either...

response.speaker: Freki
response.text: Exactly, Geri! Mondstadt was attacked by a dragon, too. And yet, wasn't it taken care of by the Knights of Favonius in the end?

response.speaker: Freki
response.text: So let's... Eh? You're that Honorary Knight, aren't you? The one who teamed up with the Knights to defeat Stormterror?

response.speaker: Freki
response.text: You see, Geri, even the Honorary Knight has come to Liyue. We're fine, there's nothing to be afraid of.

response.speaker: Freki
response.text: What's more, our gourmet journey has only just begun. We can't just stop here.

dialogues.speaker: Freki
dialogues.text: So, did you manage to get those Jade Parcels?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Here they are.

dialogues.speaker: Freki
dialogues.text: Wow, this... Come on, Geri. This one's definitely to your tastes.

dialogues.speaker: Geri
dialogues.text: Really? Well, I'll give it a try... Ooh. This aroma, it really is good...

dialogues.speaker: Freki
dialogues.text: Hahaha, it seems that Geri's been completely entranced by this dish.

dialogues.speaker: Freki
dialogues.text: Well, guess that's the end of him wanting to go back to Mondstadt. Thank you, Honorary Knight. Looks like our journey will continue after all.

talks.objective: Report back to Freki and her brother

dialogues.speaker: Ivanovich
dialogues.text: Hmm, maybe I should think of some other way...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How are you doing?

dialogues.speaker: Ivanovich
dialogues.text: Me? Hmm... You must be talking about the recent events here in Liyue Harbor. Well, I've no opinion on the matter, really.

dialogues.speaker: Ivanovich
dialogues.text: That said, the people who have been supplying me with Snezhnayan goods and who occasionally buy Cor Lapis from me are very unnerved.

dialogues.speaker: Ivanovich
dialogues.text: I've told them that there should be no problem here in Liyue, but they said that they'd only be back in a few months, and that they'll wait and see how things play out for now.

dialogues.speaker: Ivanovich
dialogues.text: Fortunately, I'd already brought in several new batches of goods, so I can last for quite a while. I'm also taking the opportunity to stock up on some Cor Lapis.

dialogues.speaker: Ivanovich
dialogues.text: I still need to man the store here, so could you help me ask Mr. Bolai if he has any Cor Lapis that I could take off his hands?

response.speaker: Ivanovich
response.text: Thank you.

response.speaker: Ivanovich
response.text: The way I see it, this is nothing too serious. The daily routine in Liyue has yet to change either, so there's no reason to panic.

response.speaker: Ivanovich
response.text: If you want to put it another way, if I stay calm while everyone else panics, aren't I ahead of the curve, then?

dialogues.speaker: Bolai
dialogues.text: You... Are you sure this is really the time to talk business with me?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It's about Ivanovich...

dialogues.speaker: Bolai
dialogues.text: Oh, you mean that outlander who does business near the mouth of the harbor. He still wants my Cor Lapis?

dialogues.speaker: Bolai
dialogues.text: Sure. I'm not one to look a gift horse in the mouth.

dialogues.speaker: Bolai
dialogues.text: I just so happen to have a batch of Cor Lapis with me. I'd originally prepared it for another customer, but they declined for now, saying that Liyue hasn't been safe of late.

dialogues.speaker: Bolai
dialogues.text: If that fellow wants to buy, then I'm happy to sell. Go tell him that — I'll stay here and prepare the goods first.

dialogues.speaker: Ivanovich
dialogues.text: So, what was Mr. Bolai's response?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: He said that he'll prepare the goods.

dialogues.speaker: Ivanovich
dialogues.text: Ah, that's great, then. He's a businessman I can trust.

dialogues.speaker: Ivanovich
dialogues.text: When my less stout-hearted merchant comrades return to Liyue Harbor, it'll be time to make a killing.

dialogues.speaker: Atsuko
dialogues.text: Ah, what am I to do...

dialogues.speaker: Atsuko
dialogues.text: Good fortune! Oh, I mean, hello... Is that right?

dialogues.speaker: Atsuko
dialogues.text: I'm still not very familiar with the local greetings. Liyue really is completely different from Inazuma...

response.speaker: Atsuko
response.text: Yes. I experienced quite a number of trials in the process of coming here.

response.speaker: Atsuko
response.text: Well, I'd always wanted to see the world, but the atmosphere in my homeland is... How should I say it? Tense? Dangerous?

response.speaker: Atsuko
response.text: Even trying to leave Inazuma's borders is fraught with difficulty, never mind attempting to travel the world. A normal person would never even make it past the many assessments that the Kanjou Commission conduct.

response.speaker: Atsuko
response.text: So I made my own raft, and sneaked over here to Liyue.

response.speaker: Atsuko
response.text: I originally intended to find work here at the wharf as a sailor, but... I have no idea where to even begin looking for that job.

response.speaker: Atsuko
response.text: Also, something must have happened in Liyue, because everything's gotten very tense all of a sudden.

response.speaker: Atsuko
response.text: I don't think there's any place that would be willing to give a job to an outlander like me, is there...

response.speaker: Atsuko
response.text: In my hometown, I would always help out at my family's store.

response.speaker: Atsuko
response.text: I'd definitely say that I'm good at delivering goods. But what I've always wanted to be is a sailor...

response.speaker: Atsuko
response.text: Eh? You want to help me find work? Thank you, that would be lovely! Ah, there are such fine people in Liyue...

response.speaker: Atsuko
response.text: Ah, yes. I did make some preparations for finding work earlier by asking around.

response.speaker: Atsuko
response.text: Those people said that if I wanted to find, ah, reliable work, I could go and find... Let me see, I'm sure I wrote it down here...

response.speaker: Atsuko
response.text: Ah, there it is. Um... So, I can look for Manager Kuan, Clerk Zhao and Nervous An.

response.speaker: Atsuko
response.text: But though I wrote it down, I'm not very familiar with the way in which local interact, so I haven't dared to ask them.

response.speaker: Atsuko
response.text: If you're willing to help me out, please help me ask them. Hopefully, one of them might be willing to hire me.

response.speaker: Atsuko
response.text: Thank you so much!

choices.text: There might not be openings for sailors...

response.speaker: Atsuko
response.text: It's alright. I wasn't hoping to become a sailor upon arrival in Liyue, anyway. Let's take it slow.

response.speaker: Atsuko
response.text: Again, thank you so much.

choices.text: What would you like to do?

response.speaker: Atsuko
response.text: Well, I'd like to be a sailor, of course! But I don't think I could start out as one...

response.speaker: Atsuko
response.text: I'd be quite satisfied as long as I can get work.

response.speaker: Atsuko
response.text: Don't underestimate me, now. Back in my hometown, I would always help out at my family's store. I'm very good at delivering goods.

choices.text: So, why did you come to Liyue?

talks.objective: Talk to Manager Kuan, Clerk Zhao, and Nervous An

dialogues.speaker: Manager Kuan
dialogues.text: *sigh* Why haven't we received notice yet...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About finding work...

dialogues.speaker: Manager Kuan
dialogues.text: Finding work? You're barking up the wrong tree. The Ministry of Civil Affairs has sealed the Chasm. Work at the Blackcliff Forge has also been stopped.

dialogues.speaker: Manager Kuan
dialogues.text: We've already got a lot of people sitting on their hands at the forge who can only do some odd jobs here and there to make ends meet. I'm afraid we are not hiring right now.

dialogues.speaker: Manager Kuan
dialogues.text: Hmph. What will the Ministry do, if the hundreds of people under me really take to the streets to find work...

talks.objective: Talk to Manager Kuan, Clerk Zhao, and Nervous An

dialogues.speaker: Nervous An
dialogues.text: You're back. How have things gone?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Do you know Atsuko?

dialogues.speaker: Nervous An
dialogues.text: Ah, I believe you're referring to that lady from Inazuma who's been asking around about work. I remember her.

dialogues.speaker: Nervous An
dialogues.text: Unfortunately, I don't think I'd have any work suited for her. As you've seen before, my data and forms all require more experienced hands.

dialogues.speaker: Nervous An
dialogues.text: Even if the Ministry of Civil Affairs were to transfer clerks over to us, they would still need some training to be able to do the job well. They'd just drag us down, otherwise.

dialogues.speaker: Nervous An
dialogues.text: It's especially difficult to look for fresh hires at a time like this, so I apologize, but I don't have work for that young lady right now.

talks.objective: Talk to Manager Kuan, Clerk Zhao, and Nervous An

dialogues.speaker: Clerk Zhao
dialogues.text: This one doesn't tally... neither does this one... And this one's requested an extension...

dialogues.speaker: Clerk Zhao
dialogues.text: Do I really have to go and chase them myself before these forms will be completed!?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What's happening...

dialogues.speaker: Clerk Zhao
dialogues.text: Not much. It's just a whole stack of forms that don't have anyone to take charge of them right now. If I don't slap them down on some tables myself, everyone just asks for extensions.

dialogues.speaker: Clerk Zhao
dialogues.text: There are so many other things I need to do right now, what with the situation in Liyue and all. How am I supposed to take the time out to rush these people?

dialogues.speaker: Clerk Zhao
dialogues.text: The Ministry of Civil Affairs can't spare any people either, so these forms are just stacking up and turning into an eyesore!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Does chasing forms need any special skills?

dialogues.speaker: Clerk Zhao
dialogues.text: Special skills? No, not really. I've already written the details of the request and their deadlines down. I just need someone to get those forms in front of the appropriate people.

dialogues.speaker: Clerk Zhao
dialogues.text: If the forms arrive and those people still don't want to settle them or ask for delays, and thus cause our work to not be completed on time...

dialogues.speaker: Clerk Zhao
dialogues.text: Hmph. They can explain themselves to the Ministry of Civil Affairs later.

dialogues.speaker: Clerk Zhao
dialogues.text: So, do you want to help? Or do you know someone who can? I welcome both.

choices.text: I know a friend who can help.

response.speaker: Clerk Zhao
response.text: That's great. Get them to come here and report to me. The quicker these are all settled, the better.

response.speaker: Clerk Zhao
response.text: Earnestness and responsibility. That's all I ask.

response.speaker: Clerk Zhao
response.text: Is your friend willing to help? Great. Ask them to report here directly. The sooner these forms are cleared, the better.

dialogues.speaker: Atsuko
dialogues.text: So, how did they respond?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Clerk Zhao has work for you...

dialogues.speaker: Atsuko
dialogues.text: That's great! What is it, specifically? ...Chasing forms... I've never heard of such work.

dialogues.speaker: Atsuko
dialogues.text: Liyue really is a completely different place from Inazuma.

dialogues.speaker: Atsuko
dialogues.text: But I'll give it my all, regardless of what work it is!

dialogues.speaker: Atsuko
dialogues.text: Thank you so much. I'll make some preparations first, and then I'll report for work.

dialogues.speaker: Atsuko
dialogues.text: With this, I can finally take a step towards carving out a new life for myself.

dialogues.speaker: Nervous An
dialogues.text: How have things gone? Have you finished settling matters?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I have.

dialogues.speaker: Nervous An
dialogues.text: Thank you. Now, leave the rest to me. Apart from our work with the outlanders, the Ministry of Civil Affairs is also calming the local populace even as we speak.

dialogues.speaker: Nervous An
dialogues.text: I do not know how much good we're doing, but I say that in such times, we should all do what we can.

dialogues.speaker: Nervous An
dialogues.text: Take this as thanks for your work. You're also a guest from afar, but your timing was truly unfortunate...

dialogues.speaker: Nervous An
dialogues.text: I can only hope that this will all blow over soon...

dialogues.speaker: Freki
dialogues.text: It seems that Zhongyuan Chop Suey just isn't Geri's thing.

dialogues.speaker: Freki
dialogues.text: I mean, he finds it even more terrifying than the accident that occurred during the Rite of Descension. *chuckles*

dialogues.speaker: Freki
dialogues.text: Hopefully, those Jade Parcels can restore his faith in Liyue's gourmet cuisine.

dialogues.speaker: Geri
dialogues.text: I still think we should go back to Mondstadt. *sigh* I could even do with a Satisfying Salad right now...

dialogues.speaker: Bolai
dialogues.text: Hmph. In business, he who dares wins!

dialogues.speaker: Ivanovich
dialogues.text: One who shrinks away from risk so easily cannot do business.

dialogues.speaker: Atsuko
dialogues.text: Truly, Liyue is a bustling city. I mean, so is Inazuma...

dialogues.speaker: Atsuko
dialogues.text: But the feeling that the two cities give off in their daily "bustle" is completely different.

dialogues.speaker: Atsuko
dialogues.text: I can't say it in a way that you would understand, but you'll see what I mean, should you ever get the chance to go to Inazuma.

dialogues.speaker: Atsuko
dialogues.text: That said... I'd say it's best that you don't go to Inazuma. I don't mean to speak ill of my homeland, but Inazuma isn't a very suitable place for traveling at present.

dialogues.speaker: Geri
dialogues.text: ...This dish is really great. Liyue is so strange — on the one hand, you have terrifying dishes like that Zhongyuan Chop Suey, and on the other, there's wonderful flavors like this one...

dialogues.speaker: Freki
dialogues.text: How is that strange? Didn't I say that Liyue has a lot of famous dishes? We haven't even come close to tasting them all!

dialogues.speaker: Ivanovich
dialogues.text: Who knows how long these goods will last. Why, those cowardly fellows. How could they have let such a business opportunity slip through our fingers...

dialogues.speaker: Nervous An
dialogues.text: Everything's happening all at once. What a mess...

dialogues.speaker: Nervous An
dialogues.text: *sigh* When will things go back to normal...

dialogues.speaker: Clerk Zhao
dialogues.text: We need to settle all these matters all quickly as possible...

dialogues.speaker: Manager Kuan
dialogues.text: *sigh* When will we be able to fully resume our work...

dialogues.speaker: Atsuko
dialogues.text: I hope someone's willing to give me a job...
